name: Gong
positioning: Gong markets itself as a Revenue AI Operating System (Revenue AI OS): conversation/interaction data via the Gong Revenue Graph, applications (Engage, Forecast, Enable, Agents), and an agentic execution layer (Gong Revenue Harness) for governed custom agents. Self-label is Revenue AI / Revenue AI OS, not AI SDR or AI CRM.

recent.title: Mission Callisto at Celebrate '26: Gong Enrich, Agent Builder, Deep Mode, Dashboards + Gong Activate framing
recent.summary: Celebrate '26 keynote product drop. Mission Callisto: Gong Enrich (third-party account/contact waterfall into Revenue Graph; partners Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, LeadIQ, etc.) GA; Agent Builder for event-triggered Custom Agents; Deep Mode in Gong Assistant GA (Gong Credits); expanded Gong Dashboards GA for Forecast users. Gong Activate announced as next-gen Revenue AI / self-improving revenue loop. Auto-triggered Custom Agents roll later in 2026. Blog: https://www.gong.io/blog/mission-callisto-revenue-ai PR: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/gong-announces-mission-callisto-unveils-sales-enrichment-layer-for-revenue-teams-302893939.html

recent.title: Gong Collective: 400+ integrations; MCP framed as part of Revenue Harness
recent.summary: Company blog states ecosystem hit 400+ integrations and that MCP support is part of the Gong Revenue Harness (Gong as MCP client and server).

recent.title: Gong available in Microsoft Marketplace / Azure; MCP support live
recent.summary: Press: Gong listed in Microsoft Marketplace with Azure Consumption Commitment (MACC) purchasing; deeper Microsoft ecosystem integrations; MCP support described as live. Companion blog: https://www.gong.io/blog/architect-smarter-revenue-ai-workflows-gong-microsoft-marketplace

recent.title: Mission Big Dipper: Gong Revenue Harness + Custom Agents
recent.summary: Product mission launch: Gong Revenue Harness as agentic execution layer; Custom Agents (natural-language, no engineering) GA; Gong Assistant expansions (AI Builder, standalone workspace) GA; Gong Enable (AI Coach, AI Builder for Scorecards) GA; Account Console Assistant and Dry Run expected July 2026. CPO Eilon Reshef: 'Every revenue leader has AI. Almost none of them are moving the number with it.' Blog: https://www.gong.io/blog/mission-big-dipper-revenue-ai-os

recent.title: Growth: ARR tops $500M; >55% YoY
recent.summary: Newsroom lists May 12, 2026 announcement: growth acceleration past 55% YoY; ARR tops $500M; tenth straight quarter of accelerating growth rate. Full release body not re-fetched beyond newsroom summary.

recent.title: Mission Andromeda: Gong Enable, Assistant, Account management, MCP
recent.summary: First named 'Mission' launch cadence: Gong Enable, Gong Assistant conversational guidance, unified account management, MCP client/server interoperability with systems such as Microsoft 365 Copilot and Salesforce Agentforce.

notes: Oct 1: Mission Callisto confirmed post-keynote. Treat Gong Activate as announced vision; Enrich/Deep Mode/Dashboards GA; auto Custom Agents later 2026.
